brief: A calm short explainer for curious adults: show Earth's water in context, then explain three water-cycle stages. Use genuine contextual footage and one original cycle animation. Do not imply that the footage proves an unobserved event.

beats.narration: From space, our planet reveals a world shaped by water. Oceans connect distant shores.

visuals.why_it_fits: Establishes the planet as the opening sentence describes the view from space

visuals.action: Ocean water moves along a coast
visuals.why_it_fits: Moves from the global view to the ocean water named in the next sentence

beats.narration: Water evaporates, forms clouds through condensation, and returns as precipitation. The cycle continues.

visuals.title: Water moves through a continuous cycle
visuals.action: The three stages form a continuous loop
visuals.why_it_fits: A looping diagram shows why water returns to earlier stages
